about_the_game:
Start your hellish journey through Sanctuary with the Crypt Hunter Pack.

Pack includes:

- 'Liath Icehowl' mount*
- 'Beginning's End' dagger skin cosmetic
- 'Protean Axe' weapon skin cosmetic
- 800 Platinum

Liath Icehowl Mount
Once used to ferry bodies to their rest, this mottled colt carries with it the trinkets of heroes long dead and buried.

Beginning's End Dagger
Formerly the bedpost of a child's crib, this sharpened timber now serves a more deadly purpose.

Protean Axe
Adaptation is the key to survival. This spade fulfills the role of both an implement of death, and a means to dispose of the body.

800 Platinum can be exchanged to customize your in-game experience with purchasable cosmetic items from the Shop, used to unlock access to the premium Battle Pass, and Battle Pass Tier Skips.
